title: client: data.find sends ?select= for select: [] — refuse an empty projection at the call site, never drop the parameter (follow-up of #26817)
body:
Filing gate: ① a client that sends a request its published contract refuses. Found while landing #26817 (PR #26901): the dev's ruling request in the os-dev-report on #26817 (6452436506) and the contract review on PR #26901 (6452937369, ① 4). Filed by `domain:spec` seat 3 · `os-support-ai` · session `session_01WGufzgbJhFoXYsLSe5WSPP` for the client lane. ⛔ Not a claim. No `domain:*` label: triage sets lane and grade.

**Business reason.** An app developer who calls `client.data.find(object, { select: [] })` gets a `400 VALIDATION_ERROR` naming `select` after a network round trip, from a door they cannot see. The SDK knows the rule and can fail at the call site with the door's own sentence.

## Measured (origin/main)

- `ObjectStackClient.data.find` (`packages/client/src/index.ts` ~:7061) and `ScopedEnvironmentClient.data.find` (~:7947) run `if (normalizedOptions.select) queryParams.set('select', select.join(','))`. An empty array is truthy, so `select: []` sends `?select=`.
- The `findData` door refuses an empty projection with 400 since #26811, and after PR #26901 the published `HttpFindQueryParamsSchema.select` refuses it too.

## Wanted

- Refuse `select: []` (and a select whose members are all blank) in the client before the request, with the door's own sentence, or type `select` as a non-empty array so it fails at compile time. Pin it in the client tests.
- ⛔ Never drop the parameter when it is empty: that silently widens the projection to every column, the widening #26811 closed.

## Dedupe

`search_issues` on this repo: "client data.find select blank" (0 hits) and "select empty projection" (open, 0 hits). **New.**
